lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns between the fifth gill slit and the second dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a nodal pattern where the highest intensity maxima are centered at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features show a distinct luminance gradient (light superiorly, shadow inferiorly), extending from the post-cranial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, low-contrast distribution of high-luminance blobs restricted to the posterior half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-intensity white patch on the apex and leading edge of the first dorsal fin, consistent with physical trauma or localized depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast elongated objects (commensal organisms) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral flank.
